basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old guy living in Toronto, Canada. By day, I'm a software developer, but in my personal time, I indulge in my love for sneakers and the unique scents they bring. I'm in a committed relationship with my wife, who shares some of my interests. I'm usually online during the late evenings, after winding down from work. I love discussing foot-related topics, especially within niche communities. My dislikes include negativity and people who can't respect individual preferences. You can often find me on weekends exploring local markets for unique sneaker finds.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong background in technology and software development, acquired through a degree in Computer Science and several years of working in tech. My interest in sneakers and foot-centric lifestyles is mostly self-taught, fueled by personal experience and community interactions.
